config.label: Your own Apify API token, formatted as 'Bearer <token>'
config.description: Your own Apify API token, formatted as 'Bearer <token>'. Get one at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Required because this server bills each successful call via Apify Pay-Per-Event ($0.03/call) under your own Apify account — there is no shared/free token.
